content:
The Final Event of the Circular Buildings Project takes place on 8 September, at 10:00am. Registration for the event is free, but mandatory and must be made here.


This event, like the project itself, is promoted by the Associação Smart Waste Portugal, in partnership with three of BUILT CoLAB's associates, 3Drivers, the Faculdade de Engenharia da Universidade do Porto (FEUP) and PTPC – Plataforma Tecnológica Portuguesa da Construção, and funded by the EEA Grants.


The Circular Buildings project began in May 2020 with the aim of developing decision-support tools to promote increased reuse of materials and reduced waste production in the Construction sector.


Find out more on the project page here.
